deploybot: Scheduled private rollout for Cerberus Labs (tenant=cerberus-7891) to dedicated pool cerberus-dedicated-1.
Details: release v2.14.1 -> inference-runtime 1.9.0-rc2, change window 2026-04-02 02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary slice: slice-3 (5% traffic) for 20m. Pin requested: model-service@v2026-04-02. Please ack and call any blockers.

maria: ack. I'll run the canary health checks 10m before window. pinging sam for SRE guardrails.

sam: looking. quick question — KMS key rotation is scheduled 2026-04-02 01:30 UTC for another tenant. That collides with our window. Can we shift or is the key rotation scoped to a different KMS partition?

elaine: if KMS rotation collides we should avoid start-of-window traffic shifts. Maria, can you confirm whether Cerberus uses the org-wide KMS or their own customer key?

maria: Cerberus is on customer-managed key (cmk-cerb-01). Rotation shouldn't touch our control plane keys. I verified with infra — rotation is for org/kms-main, different ARN.

pm_dan: good. Add to release notes: known changes (runtime switch, quantization profile update), rollback plan, and expected cost delta. I'll be on-call for the first hour.

sam: proposed traffic shift plan:
1) start canary: 5% -> monitor 20m
2) step to 25% over 5m if p95 latency < 120ms and error rate < 0.2%
3) step to 60% over 10m if still healthy
4) full cutover to 100% after 20m stable
Rollback triggers: error rate > 1% sustained 2m OR p95 increase > 40% vs baseline -> immediate rollback to previous model-service@v2026-03-30

maria: sounds good. I'll pin the tenant to model-service@v2026-04-02 in the control-plane configs prior to canary.

ops_bot: preflight check results for cerberus-dedicated-1: GPU nodes healthy=12/12, disk usage < 45%, available slots for canary=8, autoscaler cooldown=5m. No active alerts.

sam: add runbook snippet we'll use for quick rollback:
```sh
# rollback
redwoodctl tenant set-model --tenant cerberus-7891 --model model-service@v2026-03-30
redwoodctl rollout abort --tenant cerberus-7891 --pool cerberus-dedicated-1
```

elaine: monitoring hooks: watch per-route p95, token-per-second, KV cache hit rate, and model output-quality evals (we have baseline eval set "cerb-smoke-512"). If quality regression > 0.5% we stop and rollback.

pm_dan: can someone paste the release notes and the contact rotation schedule into the thread before EOD? ops, SRE, and PM on call list.

maria: added release notes to the docs page and pinned model; contact rotation: maria, sam, dan, elaine, oncall (30m overlap). I'll also create the canary dashboard link in a follow-up message.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll be in the channel at T-15 and will trigger the canary start. If anything looks off, we'll abort and revert to v2026-03-30.

deploybot: Deploybot: roll request accepted. Canary job queued. Run ID: rb-3102023456-cerb. Will post status updates here.
